note: HTTP 200 whose data.audio is not hex at all — the shape a proxy or a partial write produces. It matters because Buffer.from(x, 'hex') TRUNCATES SILENTLY at the first character that is not hex: without a guard this body becomes a short file on disk and a made answer, and the run goes on with audio nobody can play. It throws instead. This is the mp3 cousin of D-019's reasoning trap, where a call that returns nothing reads as a schema failure and is not one.
